What is Dermapen?

This treatment uses a needle thinner than a hair to temporarily make small holes in the skin, increasing the skin's natural healing ability to improve and prevent skin problems.
Stimulation with needles creates a state similar to when the skin is reborn, promoting collagen production and metabolism, improving sagging, enlarged pores, acne scars, fine wrinkles, etc.

Do you have any problems like this?

  • I am concerned about black pores and enlarged pores.
  • Sagging skin and wrinkles under the sagging skin become more noticeable
  • I'm worried about acne scars
  • Fine wrinkles become more common with age
  • Skin has lost its firmness and elasticity
  • skin is dull

Does it also work on pores? Effects obtained with Dermapen

Effects of dermapen

The following effects can be expected from Dermapen:

Improvement of wrinkles, spots, dullness, and firmness

Promotes the production of ingredients such as collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid, improving wrinkles, age spots, dullness, and firmness.

Acne scar (crater) improvement and acne prevention

It promotes skin regeneration and has the effect of calming inflammation, so it is effective not only for improving acne scars but also for preventing acne.

Tighten pores and improve skin quality

By normalizing sebum secretion and promoting skin regeneration, it can be expected to make pores less noticeable and improve skin quality.

lift up

By allowing the beauty ingredients to penetrate through the small holes, you can also expect a lifting effect.

When can I start feeling the effects? How often and how many times?

You can expect to see the effects of Dermapen after just one treatment. On average, in most cases, you will notice a clear effect after the 5th treatment.
You can get better results by continuing to use it once every 3 to 4 weeks. If you want to treat deep acne scars, please aim for 5 to 10 treatments.

Advantages and disadvantages

Benefits

Promotes skin regeneration and is effective against pores and acne scars

Promotes skin regeneration by creating conditions similar to when the skin is reborn.
It can be expected to be effective against a wide range of symptoms, including enlarged pores and acne scars.

Needles can be adjusted depending on symptoms and purpose

By adjusting the depth of the needle depending on the type and severity of the symptoms, as well as the target skin condition, we strive to provide even greater satisfaction to each patient.

You can choose the drug that suits your concerns

The treatment involves making small holes in your skin. Depending on your concerns and symptoms, we can also introduce medications from there.
Compared to simply applying drugs to your skin, the ingredients can penetrate deeper.

Can be used in conjunction with other treatments

It is also possible to obtain further effects by using it in conjunction with other treatments such as photofacials and peeling.

Disadvantages

side effects may occur

Side effects such as internal bleeding, redness, and swelling may occur.
If any side effects occur, your doctor will take prompt action.

Treatment cannot be applied to melasma

If Dermapen is applied to melasma, it may cause inflammation and pigmentation, worsening the symptoms, so it cannot be applied to areas where melasma is occurring.

It takes time to feel the effects

With Dermapen, you cannot immediately feel the effect after one treatment.
The treatment is continued at intervals of 3 to 4 weeks, and most people feel the effects after about the 5th treatment.

Care must be taken with post-surgery skin care

You cannot use sunscreen or moisturizer for 6 hours after the treatment. Also, you cannot take a bath on that day. Please only take showers.
We will explain the details of skin care individually.

Is dermapen painful? Downtime and precautions

About pain caused by Dermapen

At our clinic, we minimize pain by applying a numbing cream before the procedure. There are individual differences, but you will hardly feel any pain.

downtime

Side effects such as redness, peeling, and tingling may occur, but they usually subside within a week.
During this time, avoid irritants such as ultraviolet rays and friction as much as possible.
Make-up and bathing can usually be resumed the next day.

Precautions (contraindications)

People who fall under the following conditions cannot receive treatment with Dermapen.

  • Those who are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • People with metal allergies
  • Those who have scars, acne, warts, melasma, or keloids in the desired area for treatment
  • People with skin sclerosis
  • People with skin cancer
  • People with hemophilia
  • People with fungal infections
  • People with actinic keratosis
  • Others who are deemed unsuitable by a doctor

Flow of treatment

1Medical examination/counseling

A doctor will perform an examination and provide counseling.
We will listen to the patient's symptoms and concerns in detail and determine whether Dermapen is suitable for the treatment.
If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to ask.

2Anesthesia application/treatment

Anesthetic cream will be applied to the treatment area, and once the anesthesia has taken effect, the treatment will begin.

3drug application

We apply the cosmetic agent desired by the patient and allow the ingredients to penetrate deeply.

4Aftercare

Please be careful not to irritate the treatment area.
Details of aftercare will be explained individually.
